title: Cloudflare Pages dashboard holds config the repo cannot show: build vars, runtime secrets, analytics IDs and which branches deploy
body:
Project: repo CribbNicolas/portfolio2026, production branch `main`, preset None, build `pnpm run build`, output `dist`.
Build vars (Production AND Preview): `NODE_VERSION=24` (v3 image starts at Node 18.17.1; engines need >=22.12, `astro sync` fails on 18); `PNPM_VERSION=11.1.3` (v3 ships 10.11.1); `SITE_URL` (else canonical/JSON-LD/og URLs point at https://portfolio.invalid, astro.config.mjs).
Runtime vars (Production and Preview): `BROWSER_RENDERING_ACCOUNT_ID` (plaintext), `BROWSER_RENDERING_TOKEN` (secret, ONE permission: Developer Platform > Browser Run > Edit), `PDF_REFRESH_TOKEN` (secret; unset means `?refresh=` does not exist — safe default, a render is billable).
Analytics vars, Production ONLY so previews do not pollute data: `PUBLIC_CF_BEACON_TOKEN`, `PUBLIC_CLARITY_ID`. Public by nature; read from env so they can be rotated/disabled without code. Undefined = script not rendered.
Preview deployments: Custom branches, include `staging` only. NOT 'All non-Production branches': that deploys `develop` and every `feature/*`, each a build against the 500/month quota and a public URL. A new env var the code reads must be added in the dashboard for both environments where relevant.
not_derivable: All of this lives in the Cloudflare dashboard, outside git; the repo only shows the variable names being read.

evidence.summary: Same runtime var names, configured in the dashboard in production.
